evidence_class: fakeredis swarm store, seats and masters channel and a temporary ledger folder written through the ledger write path with the master fence, two masters racing from two threads; no live swarm or ledger server. Live G10 qualification is separate.
interfaces: ledger_server.write_gate(slug): every op write on the page path and the API path runs through master_fence.Fence wrapping the talk budget, inside the locked ledger write

master_fence.Fence.apply: a master's answer on questions/<id>, set on followups/<id>/<field> or questions/<id>/out_of_scope, task_update, comment or relay on tasks/<id> is accepted from any live master seat of the swarm; a master name with no live seat that does not own the item is refused with '<item> belongs to <owner>, so <writer> cannot <verb> it'

Decider record: an accepted master decision that changed a question or follow up writes {seat, rev} under _meta.master_decisions with the owning seat, so a write by another live master keeps the owner; while its own stamp stands and only masters wrote the item since, a master with no live seat is refused with '<item> was decided by <seat> at revision <rev>, so <writer> cannot <verb> it'

Cross write record: each accepted write by a live seat other than the owner, a comment or relay included, appends {owner, seat, by, rev} to the item's list under _meta.master_cross_writes, keeping the latest 20; a post for a write that changed the item ends with 'for <owner>'

Fence.publish(rejected): after the ledger write commits, each kept decision is posted on the masters channel as its seat with MastersChannel.decision, only when the swarm has more than one master seat
master_fence.measurements(redis, slug): master_write_refusals_total from the swarm masters hash
AGENTIHOOKS_MASTER_FENCE=off in the ledger server environment turns the fence off: every master write passes as before

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards on the pull request
supported_versions.compatibility: Operator writes, non master writes, a ledger with no swarm and a swarm whose master-fence gate is off are written exactly as before (INV-R11); a single master swarm keeps every decision and posts nothing

states.observed: The owning seat is computed inside the locked write from the live master records, the phase owners and the decider record
states.committed: An accepted decision and its decider record are committed in the same ledger write; a refusal commits only its warning and the counter
states.externally_verified: None; no live multi master swarm on Anton yet

authoritative_objects: The ledger document stays the single writer of questions, follow ups and tasks; the decider record lives in its meta and is written in the same transaction
The swarm masters hash holds the phase owners and the refusal counter
The masters channel list holds each posted decision

rollback_rehearsal.action: Set AGENTIHOOKS_MASTER_FENCE=off in ~/.agentihooks/.env and let the ledger server reload: every master write passes as before; decider records stay in the ledger meta and are ignored
rollback_rehearsal.data_safety: No ledger item, inbox item or channel post is deleted; a refused write changes nothing

remaining_limitations: Questions and follow ups route to the lead, so a non lead master decides one only as the acting lead or through a decider record; per phase routing of follow ups is SV2-MST-05's hive target work
Priority and verdict writes of a master are not fenced; this package covers answering a question, deciding a follow up, setting a task and commenting or relaying onto a task
The refusal counter is kept in the masters hash and returned by master_fence.measurements; it is not shipped to the metrics outbox yet
A Redis outage lets the write through with a fail-open row in the swarm gate log, like the talk budget
A master's inbox message to a task's claimant still goes only from the task's owning master, through master_fence.check_send; ledger writes accept any live master seat

validation.red: Mutation preflight https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/39662996453 on the tests only commit d304f0474 failed touched tests: master_fence had no CROSS record, announcement took no owner and cross writes by a live master were refused
validation.unit: Mutation preflight https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/39667532598 on c8a8706bd passed touched tests and both stats shards over every test file that exercises the fence
validation.mutation: Mutation preflight https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/39667532598 green on c8a8706bd: every changed line mutant in master_fence killed

decisions: The fence runs inside the locked ledger write, so the owner check and the write never interleave with another master's; a client side check could race
Routing decides the owner, so the master an item was sent to keeps it; every live master seat holds the same authority, so any of them may act on it and the write is recorded with its writer
A question or follow up keeps its deciding seat until someone other than a master changes it, and a cross write never moves it; tasks follow their phase owner because they change all their life
The record holds only while its own stamp stands, so a write rolled back after the fence leaves no false owner
Decisions are posted after the commit and only for kept writes, so the channel never reports a decision the ledger dropped

input_preparation.met_by: tests/sv2_mst04_cases.py builds the two master ledger from tests/fixtures/swarm_v2/master-race.json

output_contract.met_by: Any live master seat writes an item another master owns; the owner is kept and the cross write is recorded with its writer

rejection_contract.met_by: A master without a live seat is refused naming the owning master, and the refused write changes nothing

recovery_contract.met_by: A decider record survives a restart and lapses on a write by someone other than a master

compatibility.met_by: Single master swarms, ledgers without a swarm and uncovered writes behave as before

authority.met_by: The writer's seat comes from its live master record, never from the name it writes as
